description: Redux reducer module for managing content flagging state in Mattermost, including settings, fields, post values, flagged posts, channels, and teams.

methods.name: settings
methods.description: Reducer for content flagging settings, updates state based on config received or user logout.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Reducer for content flagging fields, updates state based on fields received or user logout.

methods.name: postValues
methods.description: Reducer for post-specific content flagging values, updates on new values or report updates, resets on logout.

methods.name: flaggedPosts
methods.description: Reducer for flagged posts, updates on new flagged post or resets on logout.

methods.name: channels
methods.description: Reducer for channels related to content flagging, updates on new channel data or resets on logout.

methods.name: teams
methods.description: Reducer for teams related to content flagging, updates on new team data or resets on logout.
